data.name: Daana
data.gender_notes: Daana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-n-n' meaning 'to give, to grant, to bestow'. Daana is a name of great significance in Islamic culture, symbolizing the giving and sharing of blessings and gifts. It is a name for a girl who is generous and kind, always ready to help those in need. The name Daana carries the meaning “Gift, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Daana usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spirit of giving and generosity, reflecting the selfless nature of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions who shared their resources and knowledge with others.
data.etymology: Daana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daana total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Daana resonates with the Islamic belief in the importance of generosity and giving as a means to live a virtuous life and draw closer to Allah. By bestowing blessings upon others, the name Daana embodies the selfless, loving nature that Allah desires from His creation. It is a reminder to always give with a genuine and loving heart, for the pleasure of Allah, and to live a life of abundance and generosity.
